residualGaps: (1) The component list and versions come from the official CycloneDX SBOM for this exact asset, ImageMagick-7.1.2-34-portable-Q16-HDRI-x64.cdx.json. The bundle's sha256 8DCFD364... matches the GitHub release digest, and the SBOM agrees with NOTICE.txt (37 entries). The dependency commit pins come from clone-dependencies.sh in ImageMagick/Dependencies at the release tag 2026.10.13.2113 (d38cb0f9), which the 7.1.2-34 build scripts download. No build log was read. (2) Each ImageMagick/<lib> fork contains upstream source plus the .ImageMagick build config. Its version string is the SBOM's, and the fork may carry small ImageMagick-specific changes relative to the upstream release. (3) glib 2.64.3 includes PCRE 8.31 (glib/pcre, BSD-3-Clause), compiled in with PCRE_STATIC. It is noted in the glib entry but has no separate entry. (4) The jpeg-turbo-12 and -16 repos are build configs only: they recompile the jpeg-turbo source at 12/16-bit and are listed under buildRecipe. The optional deps fftw, flif and jbig are not part of the linked-runtime build and are not in the SBOM, so they are excluded. (5) The MSVC static CRT and OpenMP runtime (Microsoft, proprietary redistributable) are not open source and are not listed. Ghostscript and other external delegates named in delegates.xml are not bundled. (6) Configure.exe is a build tool (ImageMagick/Configure at tag 2026.09.21.1729) and is listed only under buildRecipe. (7) GitHub archive sizes were measured by streaming. Archives over 20 MB (cairo, exr, harfbuzz, openh264) have bytes=0, so total bytes understates the real size. The official aggregate source archive ImageMagick-7.1.2-34-Windows.7z (767,686,970 bytes, HEAD only) was assembled from main branches at release time and may not match these pins exactly.
